completionEvidence.method: Raw intake, treatment headroom, two potable stores, rejected brine, and filter marsh are calibrated with cross-connection closed.

Six condenser legs serialize intake, condense, reject, clean, store, and restart without converting a route into a destination.
Both potable tanks isolate before contaminated treatment output reaches the rejected-brine and marsh path.
Public minimum and caravan rotation are dispatched from measured isolated stores with remaining headroom recorded.
Rejected brine reaches the filter marsh, the condenser restart clears, and no potable conduit shares the discharge edge.
